articles.summary: MALMÖ, Sweden, June 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oatly Group AB (publ) (Nasdaq: OTLY), the world’s original and largest oat drink company, will report financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, on Wednesday July 22, 2026 before the U.S. market opens.
